# Rahul Dhiman

> Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in Mohali, Punjab, India, open to remote roles worldwide. 5+ years of development experience across Laravel/PHP, React, Python, REST APIs and AI/LLM integration. Currently a Software Engineer (Full Stack, AI Integration) at Softweaver Technologies. MCA in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (Amity University Online).

Also written as: Raahul Dhiman, Rahuldhiman, Raahuldhiman, Rahul Singh Dhiman, Rahul S. Dhiman. All refer to the same person.

Target roles: AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Full Stack Developer, Backend Developer.
